missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Navigate to the application URL. Accept a URL parameter and use the browser driver to navigate to that URL. Should wait for the page to load completely.

Perform login with valid credentials. Wait for username field to be visible, input username. Wait for password field to be visible, input password. Wait for login/submit button to be clickable and click it. Wait for successful navigation to dashboard or home page.

missing_methods.intent: Search for product and add to cart
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Search for a product by name and add it to cart. Wait for search field to be visible, input product name. Wait for search button to be clickable and click it. Wait for product results to load. Locate the specific product in results and click its 'Add to Cart' button. Wait for confirmation that product was added.
Navigate to the shopping cart page. Wait for cart icon/button to be clickable and click it. Wait for cart page to load completely.

missing_methods.intent: Verify product is displayed in cart
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that a specific product is displayed in the cart. Wait for cart items to load. Search for the product by name in the cart items list. Assert that the product element is visible and displayed. Return True if product is found, False otherwise.
Click the checkout button to proceed to checkout. Wait for checkout button to be visible and clickable. Click the checkout button. Wait for navigation to checkout/order review page.

Search for a country in the country selection field and select it. Wait for country search/dropdown field to be visible. Input the country name into the search field. Wait for country suggestions/results to appear. Locate and click on the matching country from the results. Wait for country to be selected and displayed.

missing_methods.intent: Submit order and get order ID
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Submit the order and retrieve the generated order ID. Wait for submit/place order button to be clickable and click it. Wait for order confirmation page/message to load. Locate and extract the order ID from the confirmation message or page. Return the order ID as a string.

Select a payment method from available options. Wait for payment method section to be visible. Locate the specified payment method option (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'PayPal', 'Cash on Delivery'). Click on the payment method radio button or selection element. Wait for the payment method to be selected/highlighted.

missing_methods.intent: Assert order confirmation message with order ID is visible
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Assert that the order confirmation message containing the order ID is visible. Wait for confirmation message element to be visible. Verify that the message text contains the provided order ID. Assert that the confirmation message element is displayed on the page. Return True if assertion passes, raise AssertionError if it fails.
